en: This is an old postage stamp, not a postcard. The image shows a monument or memorial structure with a tall rectangular tower and some trees in the foreground. There is a sun or star-like emblem in the upper left corner. The text is in Bulgarian Cyrillic script. The denomination is 14 leva. The bottom text reads 'ЦАРСТВО БЪЛГАРИЯ' (Kingdom of Bulgaria), and the top right text appears to be a dedication related to soldiers.
